mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals && cat > .mcpjam/evals/arithmetic.json <<'EOF'
{
  "schemaVersion": "2",
  "mode": "toolWorkflow",
  "reportingMode": "standard",
  "suite": {"id": "s_arithmetic_smoke", "name": "Arithmetic result regression"},
  "target": {"servers": [{"name": "Arithmetic"}]},
  "defaults": {"judge": {"enabled": false}, "iterations": 1, "passThreshold": 1, "validity": {}},
  "cases": [{"id": "c_add_2_3", "title": "2 plus 3 returns sum 5", "steps": [
    {"id": "call_add", "kind": "toolCall", "serverName": "Arithmetic", "toolName": "add", "arguments": {"a": 2, "b": 3}},
    {"id": "assert_sum", "kind": "assert", "assertion": {"type": "toolResultMatchesSchema", "toolName": "add", "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"sum": {"const": 5}}, "required": ["sum"]}}}
  ]}]
}
EOF
npx mcpjam cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arithmetic.json --project project_fixture --no-telemetry --format json > artifacts/validation.json; cat artifacts/validation.json
